the pinned file adds two refusals to proposal validation, eligible at most MaxEligible and choice labels distinct and non-empty once folded (FoldLabel, golang.org/x/text/unicode/norm; VAULT-MESSAGING 0.88.12 §10.19.4): this release accepts a superset (fail-safe); the service doesn't run the pinned Validate on its own proposals but refuses the same itself: eligible above vote.MaxEligible in vote.Proposal.Validate (vote.EncodeProposal and ParseProposal; ballot.MaxEligible is lower still), and a choice label that is empty, repeated or Abstain in ballot.checkInput's choice-label loop (internal/ballot/approved.go), so no label folds to empty (the pinned k == "" refusal); its strings.ToLower key groups labels as the fold does only while latin() admits no more than printable ASCII and the Latin-1 letters (it leaves out ª, µ and º too), so widening latin() needs a real fold check there: beyond that set the two part ways on long s (U+017F), format characters (the soft hyphen U+00AD is in Latin-1), sequences NFC changes, and classes such as µ/μ and σ/ς; no init, no package-level variable written, nothing a bundle or root check uses; see GC #11068

the vault release was built with toolchain go1.26.10 and the service with go1.26.11, a patch release; the verifier's source is the same. Of go1.26.11's changes, the verifier's dependency closure reaches: the crypto/fips140 compliance changes (self-tests when generating or importing private keys, the FIPS service indicators of HKDF-Expand and of legacy Keccak in crypto/sha3, an OAEP check in FIPS 140-only mode), net's Dialer.Dial* address handling (the verifier dials nothing), a runtime revert on 32-bit platforms only, and compiler fixes. The verifier's compiled code under the two toolchains (amd64 and arm64, the vault's build flags) is identical except in those source-changed functions, none of which is on the verification path. net/http, crypto/tls and the cgo build fixes are outside it. Listed with vettid/service-vault#196 (GO-2026-6859)
